Do not breathe exhaust fumes. 4. Use enough ventilation, exhaust at arc, or both, to keep fumes and gases from breathing zone and general area. If engineering controls are not feasible, use an approved respirator. 5. Work in a confined area only if it is well-ventilated, or while wearing an air-supplied respirator. 6. Have a recognized specialist in i ndustrial Hygiene or e nvironmental Services check the operation and air quality and make recommendations for the specific welding situation.
